returns: No returns on postage, notary, fax, scanning, or custom work after approval.
Unopened retail supplies may be returned within 14 days with a receipt.
id_requirements: Mailbox rental requires a government-issued photo ID.
Notary services require a government-issued photo ID.
Passport photo service does not require ID, but the customer should know the passport photo specifications they need.
turnaround_times: Copies and fax: same day while the store is open.
Scanning and shredding: same day or next business day depending on volume.
Flyers and posters: 1–3 business days depending on quantity and finish.
Large-format and bulk print orders: quote-based schedule provided by staff.
Mailbox rental applications: same day if ID checks out.
